entities.name: Kithkin
entities.description: A people whose minds are linked by the thoughtweft; ambidexterity is common among them.

entities.name: Thoughtweft
entities.description: The link that connects the minds of the kithkin, sharing knacks between them.

entities.name: Isanke
entities.description: A Halimar seastalker who speaks about journeys and learning.

entities.name: Halimar
entities.description: A place from which the seastalker Isanke hails.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: A figure whose song calls the faeries home, and who feasts on the stolen dreams and rumors they bring her.

entities.name: Faeries
entities.description: Beings who return home at Oona's song and serve her stolen dreams and rumors.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: One who never relinquished a grudge, letting it burn until the moment of vengeance.

entities.name: Gruul
entities.description: A group regarded by some as savage simpletons, whose shamans hold subtle power.

relations.quote: The thoughtweft links the minds of the left- and right-handed, giving each the knack of the other.

relations.note: Faeries return home and serve Oona stolen dreams and rumors
relations.quote: All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.
